And in a beautiful, clear voice, it spoke to her.
"You fell for it.
I'm no mother of yours.
You had the Rubelize, didn't you?
Then you should've just wished to meet your mother, shouldn't you?
Hee hee hee..."
(M... Mother☆)
Okazaki prayed desperately.
If her mother was out there somewhere...
If she called to her with all her heart, maybe she would come, she thought.
But...
Her mother's spirit never came to help her.
Because her mother was alive.
She had cut ties with her father, but she really was out there somewhere, living her life.
Heh heh...
Okazaki was taken away by the spirit of the schoolgirl who had played the organ.
Her soul was torn right out of her.{p}
